profile_text.body:
Peking University is a university in Beijing, China, and its English-language site describes campus life and services rather than research or teaching programs. The site notes that being part of the university means access to a wide range of retail stores and services on campus, and it points visitors to information on campus services such as bookstores, banking, and mail delivery. The page carries a copyright notice for Peking University, an address at No.5 Yiheyuan Road, Haidian District, Beijing 100871, P.R.China, and Chinese filing numbers 京ICP备05065075号-1 and 京公网安备110402430047号.

The university is also known as PKU. It is a nonprofit institution, and the material available does not identify any AI products, lawsuits, or MCP servers associated with it.
